essence: Offering flowers arisen from a four-finger measure brings prosperity
Offering citrons in oblation yields the wealth one desires
The practice brings a son, fortune, good fortune, and victory always
This śrīṃ mantra is celebrated as ten-syllabled in the five traditions
Through this mantra evil planets become benign and one becomes respected by kings
